Strength classes that fit your week

Why small groups work

Training in a small group gives you the attention of a personal coach at a fraction of the price. Every class is capped at eight members, so your coach can watch your form, adjust the load and keep you moving safely from the first warm-up set to the final stretch. Members tell us the accountability of a familiar group is the main reason they keep showing up week after week.

Our coaches hold recognised strength and conditioning certifications and plan each block of training in four week cycles. You will learn the fundamental lifts, build a base of conditioning and track your progress with simple numbers you can understand. Nobody is expected to arrive fit or experienced, and every movement has an easier and a harder version.

What a session looks like

Each fifty minute session starts with a mobility warm-up, moves into a main strength lift, continues with a short conditioning circuit and ends with a cool down. The plan for the day is written on the board before you arrive, so you always know what to expect. Coaches demonstrate every exercise and give individual cues during the working sets.

Schedules and pricing

Classes run early in the morning, at lunchtime and in the evening on weekdays, with two sessions on Saturday mornings. You can book up to two weeks ahead in the app and cancel without a fee up to four hours before class. Memberships include unlimited classes, a quarterly progress review and access to open gym hours. Your first session is free, and there is no joining fee or long contract.

Getting started

Book a free intro session, tell your coach about your goals and any injuries, and we will recommend the right starting level. Most new members feel stronger and more confident within the first month, and many go on to set personal records they never expected. Bring comfortable clothes, a water bottle and a positive attitude, and we will take care of the rest of the plan for you.
